IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Tuesday 10 November
Winds: West to northwesterly below 10 knots.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres.
Weather: Cloudy. 50% chance of showers.

Wednesday 11 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 15 to 20 knots tending south to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then turning westerly in the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Thursday 12 November
Winds: Northwesterly below 10 knots tending east to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then turning southerly in the late afternoon.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Mostly sunny.

Friday 13 November
Winds: Variable below 10 knots becoming southeasterly 10 to 15 knots during the day then becoming variable below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 50% chance of showers.

Saturday 14 November
Winds: Southwesterly below 10 knots tending southeast to southwesterly 15 to 20 knots during the morning then becoming west to southwesterly about 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 0.5 metres, increasing to around 1 metre during the morning.
Weather: Cloudy. 80% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A weakening cold front in the south west is expected to skim across the south on Tuesday night. This front is forecast to clear eastwards early Wednesday before a ridge of high pressure develops from the west. This ridge is expected to persist until Friday before it is eroded by a weak trough developing off the east coast. This trough is forecast to weaken on Saturday before a cold front approaches the west coast in the late evening.
